items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams (hamstring) left on cart, undergoing tests Monday; listed on Sunday injury watchlist. Coach notes good spirits, happy not knee.
items.implication: Severity TBD Monday; potential multi-week absence impacts CHI pass catchers

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered another dislocated left elbow, X-rays negative, expected to miss time; last occurrence he missed about a month. Ruled out of the game.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on final play of first half; coach confirms miss time
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks likely; backup QB elevated for ROS short-term

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket possible). Confirmed optimism from prior reports.
items.why: Official active list after cracked rib GTD with optimism
items.implication: Play through with possible docks; startable if projected
items.opportunity: Routes/targets expected but limited efficiency possible

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI today after stinger; hope it is minor. He played through it.
items.why: Stinger sustained, played through, MRI scheduled
items.implication: Monitor results; if limited opens more for backups

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious by HC Kyle Shanahan; could have returned in 4th quarter if needed. Demarcus Robinson suffered high ankle sprain.
items.why: Coach: not serious, could return if needed
items.implication: Low concern for next week; Robinson high ankle more impactful for depth

items.text: RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring). Grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored preseason. Levitan expected decent look at Coleman.
items.why: Hamstring, not expected then confirmed inactive
items.implication: Opens Broncos RB snaps; Coleman saw expanded role (10 carries TD)

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back), listed questionable, officially active vs Texans.
items.implication: Full go for CIN pass game

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) true game-time decision. Projecting carefully; different from prior psoas.
items.why: Hip injury, no practice consecutive days, true GTD
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; if out heavier TE/WR2 usage

items.text: Michael Pittman (foot) OUT. Expecting decent look at Germie Bernard.
items.implication: Target opportunity for PIT WRs behind Metcalf

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish. Official status late. Olave clean no docks; Harvey to Coleman look; Pittman to Bernard.
items.why: Rap bullish on McConkey; usage/injury data informed docks
items.implication: McConkey startable with caution; backups elevated for OUT players

items.text: Zay Flowers OUT (hamstring). Ravens need big game from Bateman.
items.why: Hamstring, listed OUT in weekend summary
items.implication: Target bump to other BAL WRs short-term

items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price questionable to return due to chest injury. On ETR watchlist.
items.implication: Monitor; could affect SEA RB committee

items.text: Agrees Germie Bernard deep stash (YAC man, good McCarthy fit) with Pittman out. Also McConkey active/Harvey inactive confirm.
items.why: YAC fit with offense, Pittman absence
items.implication: Deep league stash/waiver for potential target bump

items.text: Chris Olave (hamstring) sounds fine, no real docks. Officially active alongside Burrow.
items.why: Expected to play clean, confirmed active
